# python-aprs.org

Website and docs for [python-aprs.org](https://python-aprs.org).

The whole site is generated by [`build.py`](build.py):

* `index.html` — the project overview, from [`templates/index.html`](templates/index.html).
* `changelog.html` — every library's GitHub releases, fetched at build time.
  Nothing is kept by hand: publish a release with notes on GitHub (the
  "Generate release notes" button is enough) and it shows up here.
* `docs/` — API reference for each library, generated by
  [pdoc](https://pdoc.dev) from the latest release on PyPI.

The [workflow](.github/workflows/pages.yml) builds and deploys to GitHub Pages
on every push to `main`, once a day, and on demand from the Actions tab
("Run workflow"), which is the way to publish right after a release.

## Build locally

```sh
uv run build.py            # add --refresh to pick up releases newer than uv's cache
python -m http.server -d _site
```

`build.py` declares its own dependencies inline, so there's no project file or
lock to maintain. Set `GITHUB_TOKEN` if you hit the GitHub API rate limit.

## Adding a library

Add an entry to `LIBRARIES` in `build.py` and the package to the dependency
list at the top of the file.
